rows.text: subscribes **Rs 1.43 crore to a rights issue of wholly owned Etone India**, a gravure-cylinder maker whose FY26 turnover was Rs 12.70 crore.

approves **Rs 5.71 crore of plant and machinery in Karnataka**, plus Rs 1 crore of commencement costs, for a facility that at full utilisation adds **over 18,000 gravure cylinders a year** to 94,000 today, funded from internal accruals.
